description: Shared type definitions for SPEC user-record encounter events (lemma, compound, register, dialect, entity, grammar pattern). Provides the cross-record vocabulary used by RFCs 008–012. Distinct from tools.spec.event.defs (which holds signedEventBase and morphemeEncounterBase) and exists to avoid repeating the same field set across the user-records suite.

dialectProfileId.description: Canonical dialect profile id. The full set is enumerated in app/utils/dialect_region_map.py in the dictionary repo and mirrored here as a documentation pointer. The 11 canonical regions are: gyeongsang, jeju, chungcheong, hamgyeong, jeolla, gangwon-south, jungang, pyeongan, hwanghae, gangwon-north, munhwaeo. DO NOT use legacy "dialect_region" or pyeongbug / standard ad-hoc strings.

dictionaryColumnRef.description: Pointer at the specific dict.* column the encounter is grounded in. Used for cross-referential extrapolation (RFC 015). NOT all columns are applicable to every encounter type — the column list is the admissible ground-truth set.

table.description: dict.* table that supplies the ground truth.

column.description: Column name. Must be the canonical name (not a banned alias).

valueAtEncounter.description: Snapshot of the column value at the time of the encounter. Used so that later edits to dict.* do not retroactively change the recorded encounter.

encounterOutcome.description: auto_read, marked_known, reviewed_correct, mined → Y=1. lookup, hover, click, marked_unknown, reviewed_again, reviewed_incorrect → Y=0.

formalityTier.description: Canonical 5-value formality tier (Glossary Part 3). DO NOT use deprecated register_level, register_band, or register_delta values.

hostEojeol.description: The eojeol (whitespace-delimited unit) that the encounter was emitted against, plus its position in the source paragraph. Glossary Part 1 forbids using "word" / "token" for this unit.

eojeolSurface.description: Surface eojeol as it appeared in the source text.

eojeolOffset.description: 0-based eojeol index within the source paragraph.

paragraphCharStart.description: Optional character offset within the source paragraph.

hostLemmaRef.description: Canonical reference to a dictionary headword. Resolves either to a unified_entry (5-character base62 id) or to a headword_group (canonical-headword-normalized string for FK-free cross-app interop).

unifiedEntryId.description: 5-character base62 id (Glossary §1.3) of the unified_entries row. Canonical FK on the dictionary side.

headwordGroupId.description: 5-character base62 id of the headword_groups row.

canonicalHeadword.description: Canonical headword surface (Glossary Part 1). Used when the client has not yet resolved a base62 id; spec-server resolves it on ingest.

headwordDisplay.description: Normalized surface used for homograph grouping (unified_entries.headword_display). DO NOT use legacy clean_headword.

tier.description: Unified-entry tier. Encyclopedic is a distinct tier value (replaces deprecated referent / quasi_entity).

lexicalElevationType.description: Categorical honorific behavior (Glossary Part 3). DO NOT use honorific_type / politeness_type.

resolverConfidence.description: Confidence that the encounter resolution (e.g. host-lemma id, compound-type label, entity surface) is correct, as assigned by the Sunbi/bibim resolver at encounter time. Below 0.6 should be flagged for review before feeding BKT/IRT.

sensitivityClass.description: Sensitivity classification (Glossary Part 8.5). Triggers E2E encryption in the client storage pipeline (RFC 016).
